description: ΕΓΚΥΚΛΙΟΙ ISPS ΠΛΟΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΩΝ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΥ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΠΛΟΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΩΝ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ. The publisher named on the listing is ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΥ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΠΛΟΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΛΙΜΕΝΙΚΩΝ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
